CHANGING WHAT’S POSSIBLE WITH FINANCING OPTIONS

At Synchrony, we work with thousands of businesses – large and small – helping national chains and local merchants offer credit cards with the budget-friendly financing and purchasing power that you need to buy that laptop, tablet, washer, dryer or dishwasher on your wishlist and pay for in monthly installments.  

The application process is easy. How does it work?

Step 1

Find an offer or retailer that you love.

Step 2

Apply for the credit card of your choice.

Step 3

If approved, take advantage of deals that help you purchase what you want and what you need and make your monthly payments!

Flexible ways to apply

You may notice some Synchrony partners offer prequalify and apply options, but which is right for you? Here's some information to help you decide.

  • Click PREQUALIFY to find out if you qualify for credit.

    • There is no impact to your credit bureau score.
    • Get a decision in seconds. If you prequalify, then apply.

  • Click APPLY if you're confident you'll be approved.

    • Completing an application may impact your credit score.
